verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke's own incentives page says it advises on the full range of employee incentives, naming tax-advantaged UK EMI plans, company share option plans and growth shares. Its EC/VC team also includes incentives specialists for high-growth companies. However, the evidence documents only UK schemes, with no first-party page describing German VSOP/ESOP or Indian ESOP design. missing for 10: documented German VSOP/ESOP advice, documented Indian ESOP advice, detail on program design scope, independent corroboration

support.subject: As a founder, the firm designs employee equity programs — option plans and local schemes like UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP, or Indian ESOPs — described on its own pages

citations.quote: Our lawyers have a wealth of experience in advising on the full range of employee incentives, including: tax-advantaged enterprise management incentive (EMI) and company share option plans
We bring together corporate, regulatory, commercial, IP, incentives, employment and tax specialists to support innovation-driven businesses and their investors throughout their lifecycle
